analysis: Documentation-only change in docs/reference/protocol-messages.md: bumps the date (line 3), clarifies that performance_measurements sample_age_ms is elapsed time since the newest observation (line 578), and adds a paragraph (lines 580-584) saying the Swift producer applies the same age rule to workload buckets and current-posture series (EnginePerformanceMeasurements.swift). It also states that wire fields are unchanged and that completed samples keep receipt-order EWMA and counts. No security controls, auth, crypto, App Attest resumption, drain, or routing semantics changed. performance_measurements are described as transient routing observations from the provider, which is adversarial under TB-002. The doc text does not alter that trust model. The coordinator clamps and reconciles these values and does not gate routing on them, but that clamping lives in the platform repo and was not in the supplied evidence. The Swift source for EnginePerformanceMeasurements.swift was not supplied, so the claimed producer behavior is unverified. Nothing here invalidates TB-002 or TB-011 assumptions or the cited threats (T-007, T-053 to T-058). Surrounding unchanged sections (resume protocol, drain) were read for context and have no new issues from this PR.
